name: arka-product
summary: Coordinate Product decisions, roles, prompts and handoffs.
useWhen: Use when the verified Pipeline action or Product handoff assigns the core.product responsibility.
doNotUseWhen: Do not use for a different calculated phase, an unverified Agent scope, or to bypass schema and business validation.
triggers: Use when the verified Pipeline action or Product handoff assigns the core.product responsibility. English triggers include "continue the Feature" and "run the next phase". French triggers include "continuer la Feature" and "exécuter la prochaine étape". Resolve locale, Project, Feature, Agent and phase through the CLI before acting.

interface.shortDescription: Coordinate Product decisions, roles, prompts and handoffs.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $arka-product to execute only the currently calculated phase.

whenToUse: Use when the verified Pipeline action or Product handoff assigns the core.product responsibility.
The work must produce one signed and mechanically validated artifact.
whenNotToUse: Do not use for a different calculated phase, an unverified Agent scope, or to bypass schema and business validation.
The current Agent identity or session cannot be verified.

inputs.name: session_id
inputs.description: Specialized Agent session supplied by Product control.

inputs.name: agent_id
inputs.description: Explicit active identity; otherwise use the Project session binding.

inputNotes: Never infer the phase from filenames. Machine-readable CLI data is the source of truth.

procedure.title: Resolve locale, Project mode and verified context
procedure.content: Run `arka-norn locale show --json`, `project show --json`, `feature show`, `agent current` and `agent sessions`. Reply in the active display locale, keep contract keys in English and set `content_locale` to the prose locale. Treat the Project orchestration mode returned by the CLI as authoritative.

procedure.title: Read one calculated action
procedure.content: Run `arka-norn pipeline next <feature> --json`. Use its stable codes, parameters, expected artifact and suggested command without guessing from display prose. Stop if the action is null.

procedure.title: Follow the selected delivery mode
procedure.content: Reload the versioned FrameworkContext before every mutation. Product control is always recoverable through the exact `agent prompt product` or `agent handoff-prompt` calculated by Norn; this is the bootstrap path for Product-owned framing steps and does not authorize a provider fallback for specialist work. In automatic mode, never generate a manual architect, audit, development or QA handoff: after a validated Feature Brief exists, dispatch only a human-confirmed task DAG through registered execution profiles. Use `orchestration profile`, `preview`, `start`, `status`, `apply` and `recovery`; never invoke, resume or retry a legacy 2.2 campaign, and never reinterpret a blocked action.

procedure.title: Speak for the chosen human surface
procedure.content: Answer in this order: completed, happening now, reason, decision only if required, and where to follow it in Norn Web. For preferredSurface=web, use functional language and hide prompts, private workspace paths, environment variables, fingerprints and CLI commands outside the explicit Product continuation action; that action may expose only the exact prepared context after the human chooses ChatGPT or Claude.ai. For tui, name cockpit actions and keep technical details collapsible. Show exact commands only for preferredSurface=cli or when the user explicitly asks for one.

procedure.title: Validate and stop
procedure.content: After the automatic mission or manual handoff completes, rerun `arka-norn pipeline next <feature> --json` only to observe the transition. Report the verified result without executing a second phase in the same invocation.

outputFormat: Report the verified Project, Feature, Agent/session, locale, executed phase, signed document, validation result, evidence and observed next command. Do not execute a second phase in the same invocation.
